_comment: What the ground is made of. One file for both ends of it: the bakery reads set, variant, tint and keep_colour to bake the texture, and the renderer reads the rest every frame to blend one material into the next. Kept together because they are one decision - how this stuff looks - and split across two files they drift apart. metres_per_turn is how much ground one turn of the texture covers: bigger is a larger pattern and fewer repeats. blend_width is how wide the border with a neighbour is, in weight; tear is how far noise tears that border about; tear_metres is how big the tears are. The border between two materials takes the average of their widths, the larger of their tears and the smaller of their sizes - what makes a border soft is a property of the stuff on either side of it.
name: grass

_comment: Not in the six the ground blends between - these two are baked for the sprite and cliff work and for whoever wants a second grass - but they are materials all the same and belong in the same file.
